market_specific_notes: Chicago TRT shoppers usually need a better comparison of candidacy screening, lab cadence, and follow-up process instead of general hormone-optimization branding.
In Chicago, the most useful first-screen comparison is how clinics explain monitoring, refill logic, and escalation rules.
local_vetting_points: Ask what labs are required before treatment starts.
Ask how follow-up, dose changes, and refill timing are handled.
Ask what symptoms or lab changes trigger review between visits.
typical_cost_ranges: Clinic pricing in Chicago can shift based on lab frequency, visit cadence, medication form, and whether ancillaries are bundled.
A low monthly number is not meaningful without the monitoring schedule.
payment_options: Ask whether labs, follow-up visits, medications, and telehealth check-ins are bundled or billed separately.
Ask whether membership pricing changes after the initial onboarding period.
wait_time_notes: Wait time should be judged by consult speed, lab turnaround, prescription timing, and first follow-up timing together.
Fast onboarding is not the same thing as a good monitoring plan.
availability_notes: Availability should include whether the clinic supports telehealth, weekend labs, refill responsiveness, and mid-cycle questions.
Ask who handles issues between scheduled visits.
named_resources_or_providers: Chicago-area independent lab locations, primary-care alternatives, and insurer/lab cash-pay comparison tools are often more useful than branded clinic lists.
Use lab-access and follow-up reality as part of the local comparison.
city_intro_override: Chicago TRT shoppers usually make better decisions when they compare screening, monitoring, and refill logistics instead of hype or speed-to-intake.

primary_city_decision_block.title: Chicago TRT clinic-screening checklist
items: Compare candidacy screening, lab cadence, and refill process.
Ask what safety monitoring happens after the first prescription.
Do not let intake speed replace treatment-quality comparison.

lab_work_notes: Ask what baseline labs are required before treatment starts and how often follow-up labs are expected.
Do not treat same-week onboarding as proof that monitoring is thorough.
therapy_types_available: Ask whether the clinic handles injections, creams, pellets, or other options and how they decide fit.
The real comparison is screening quality and monitoring, not branding.
monitoring_frequency_notes: Ask when the first follow-up happens, how dose changes are handled, and when symptoms versus labs trigger changes.
Ask whether follow-up cadence changes after stabilization.
fertility_or_hair_considerations: If fertility, hair, or body-composition goals matter, ask how those considerations change the plan before you pay.
